name: Raycast MCP Bridge
description: Local Raycast extension that routes natural-language commands to macOS tools via MCP.

name: Slack Concierge Bot
description: Internal Slack app for IT requests: calendar scheduling, device info, and notifications.

name: Helpdesk Triage Agent
description: Automates ticket intake: creates reminders, drafts emails, and files screenshots to Finder.

name: Executive Assistant Automations
description: Calendar + Mail workflows for leadership; stricter policies and shorter quotas.

name: Notion Sync Utility
description: Copies meeting notes from Notes into Notion via clipboard; read-heavy with occasional writes.

name: iTerm Runbook Runner
description: Runs approved shell runbooks in iTerm for on-call (log collection, service checks).

name: Calendar Clean-up Job
description: Nightly job to archive old all-day holds and normalize recurring meeting titles.

name: QA Automation Harness
description: Integration test runner for MCP tools; exercises validation and policy-deny paths.

name: Sales Demo Controller
description: Drives scripted demos: Finder prep, Notifications cues, and Pages doc generation.

name: Personal Shortcut Relay
description: Bridges iOS Shortcuts to the Mac host for Messages, Notes, and clipboard actions.

name: Compliance Archive Agent
description: Exports selected Mail threads and Calendar invites for audit holds; limited scope.

name: Onboarding Setup Assistant
description: Creates welcome notes, schedules orientation events, and opens required URLs in Finder/Safari.

name: Finance Close Checklist Bot
description: Generates Pages checklists and calendar reminders for monthly close.

name: Message Blaster Prototype
description: Prototype for bulk Messages outreach; suspended after policy review flagged auto-send risk.

name: Unmanaged Mac Mini Host
description: Legacy client tied to a retired host identity; authentication disabled pending re-provision.

name: Deprecated Alfred Workflow
description: Old Alfred workflow replaced by Raycast; kept for historical audit only.

name: Legacy Mail Merge Tool
description: Retired mail-merge integration; deleted after repeated rate-limit and validation failures.
